summary: V11 cannot be met inside the plan's rulings, and the product is harmed. The eight renamed-repo jobs (MyDownloads/*, ScanToPdf/* and their AaC twins) never built after the push, and no future push will start them either. Their GitHub Hook Logs show why: each poll compares against the old *master* checkout the last build recorded, ls-remote finds only main, and the poll answers 'No changes'. One build on main re-baselines them, but only a hand start can give it, and the plan's Ordering constraints and V18 allow no hand start beyond AaC/Architecture's. The operator rules whether the run may start each of the eight once by hand; the rest is covered: P13 and P14 fix the two red builds and the test phase pushes them next, and V23-V25 are owed_after.
